name: Illinois Switchboard Corporation
old_description: was established in 1971 and has been providing outstanding electrical metering and distribution equipment ever since.
about:
Illinois Switchboard Corporation was established in 1971 in Addison, Illinois. The company has operated continuously since its founding, focusing on electrical metering and distribution equipment.

The company manufactures and designs electrical switchboards (up to 4000 amp), power and lighting panelboards, industrial control panels, and electrical enclosures with welded steel construction. It also produces special sheetmetal fabrications and specializes in alterations and additions to existing switchboards, including bus details and circuit breaker retrofits for any brand. A quick-ship program offers NEMA 1 distribution panels in 60-, 75-, and 90-inch heights, with main lug ratings from 400 to 1200 amps and main breaker ratings from 400 to 800 amps. The firm stocks a large selection of Siemens circuit breakers, fusible switches, and components, and says it can handle orders ranging from one to 1,000 pieces.

Illinois Switchboard serves customers needing electrical distribution and control equipment, including contractors, original equipment manufacturers, and facility operators who require modifications to installed gear. Its engineering staff assists with design and retrofit questions.

The company differentiates itself by offering rapid turnaround on stocked distribution panels, the ability to modify existing switchboards from any manufacturer, and an inventory of Siemens components that supports quick delivery.
